purpose: Provider rows models.dev does not carry: models published only at lab level, and providers models.dev does not list. Current reads serve these rows from this file; every start also records each row's claim in the store, so a point-in-time read serves the claim in force at its instant. Login methods are an allowlist, not a preference.

models.source_ref: Read 2026-11-13. https://platform.openai.com/docs/pricing#audio-tokens: "gpt-live-transcribe | Live transcription | - | - | $0.017 / minute". https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-live-transcribe: "GPT-Live-Transcribe"; "Input modalities: audio, text"; "Output modalities: text"; "Realtime audio duration", "Price | $0.017 | minute". Served as $0.017 per 60 seconds, not a token rate. No rounding rule or minimum is stated, so increment and minimum_quantity are unknown; GPT-Live-1's per-second rule is not applied. The model page lists "Realtime transcription | v1/realtime/transcription_sessions | Supported": used through Realtime transcription sessions at https://api.openai.com/v1/realtime/transcription_sessions. The curated API base is the same OpenAI v1 base; no unverified wire.family is served.

Read 2026-11-13. https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing#gemini-3.5-transcribe-live: "Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live", "Our low-latency, real-time speech-to-text model for bidirectional streaming audio transcription over WebSockets."; "Paid Tier, per 1M tokens in USD"; Input price "$3.50 or $0.005/min* (audio)"; "Output price (including thinking tokens)" "$21.00 or $0.004/min* (text)". "Estimated pricing is based on 25 audio tokens per second for input and 175 text tokens per minute for output, for an effective blended rate of ~$0.009 per min for Live Transcribe." A Free Tier is listed as "Free of charge" for input and output. Served rates are the paid per-million-token prices; the per-minute figures are Google's estimates, not the billing unit. The audio conversion follows the pricing footnote, not Google's general 32-token audio default. https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-3.5-transcribe lists "gemini-3.5-transcribe-live (Live API)" and the pricing link "Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live". The curated API base matches the Gemini API base served for google/gemini-3.8-flash; no unverified wire.family is served.

Read 2026-11-10. https://platform.openai.com/docs/models/gpt-image-2.6-flare: "gpt-image-2.6-flare", "GPT Image 2.6 Flare". Text: "Input | $5 | 1M tokens", "Cached input | $1.25 | 1M tokens". Image: "Input | $8 | 1M tokens", "Cached input | $2 | 1M tokens", "Output | $30 | 1M tokens". Supported endpoints: "/v1/images/generations" and "/v1/images/edits"; Responses is not supported. https://platform.openai.com/docs/pricing: Flare text output "-", so no rate.output is served. Cached image input is unserved: there is no cached-image role, and the guide states cached pricing applies only through the Responses API, which this model does not support. The text cache-read price is retained as the model page states it; endpoint applicability must be checked by the caller. Text and image input produce image output.

Read 2026-11-10. https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing: per 1M tokens in USD, input "$1.50 (text / image / video)"; output "$9.00 (text)", "$12.00 (video)"; "calculated at a rate of 5,792 tokens per second of 720p video"; 360p "1,931 tokens/s", 1080p with upsampling "8,688 tokens/s", 4K with upsampling "17,376 tokens/s". https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-omni-flash: Stable "gemini-omni-1.2-flash", "Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash". https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/omni: "Interactions API", "POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions". Image, text and video input; text and video output. Output conversions are resolution-selected token counts, not time-billed rates; 1080p and 4K include upsampling. No unstated context, output limit or audio conversion is served. Video facts read 2026-11-14. https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/omni: "You can set the video `duration` in `response_format` to any whole second from 3 to 15 seconds (for example, `"15s"`)." "Setting a duration over 15 seconds returns an invalid argument error." The documented "up to 30 seconds total for extended videos" is extension, not one generated clip. Aspect ratios: "Supported values: "9:16", "16:9""; "Landscape (16:9) is the default." Audio: "By default the model will try to generate an appropriate audio track for a video." https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-omni-flash: output video "3s-15s"; output "Video with native Audio, Text". Google documents no audio on/off switch and does not promise silent output.

Read 2026-11-10. https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing: "Paid Tier, per 1M tokens in USD"; input "$0.50 (text) through December 31, 2026."; output "$9.00 (audio) through December 31, 2026."; "Audio tokens correspond to 25 tokens per second of audio." Both prices double on 2027-01-01 to $1.00 input and $18.00 audio output; those future prices are not served. https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-3.8-flash-tts: "Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS"; "Input token limit 8,192"; "Output token limit 16,384"; supported methods include "GenerateContent". https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/speech-generation: model id "gemini-3.8-flash-tts"; text input and audio output. No text-output rate is stated, so no rate.output is served.

Text to Speech $0.08 per 1,000 characters (multilingual models) or $0.04 (Flash/Turbo)."; "Text to Speech is billed per character." https://elevenlabs.io/docs/overview/models: "eleven_flash_v2_5", "Eleven Flash v2.5", "40,000 characters per request". OpenAI's Decisions API: POST /v1/decisions with model gpt-6-luna. This row is that endpoint, not the gpt-6-luna chat row. Read 2026-11-04 at https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/decisions: "Send requests to `POST /v1/decisions` using `gpt-6-luna`, the only currently supported model."; "The Decisions API evaluates text, images, and JSON and returns typed answers"; "Files, audio, and item references aren't supported."; "Provide images as inline base64 data URLs or publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URLs."; "With `gpt-6-luna`, uncached input costs **$0.10 per 1M tokens**. Prompt cache hits receive discounted input pricing; cache writes are charged. Cache-read and cache-write rates match the standard `gpt-6-luna` prompt caching rates. Output tokens are not charged."; "Regional processing premiums and long-context input pricing multipliers apply." https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, standard table, row gpt-6-luna: short context cached input $0.01, short context 30m write $0.125, 12h write $0.25. Served: the short-context rates and the 30-minute cache write. Not served: the 12-hour cache write, long-context rates above 272K input tokens, and regional premiums, so a long-context or regional request costs more than these rates. The page states no context window or image size limits.
